attribution: Yangke L (2025), “Indoor Waste Image Dataset,” Mendeley Data v1, DOI: 10.17632/dy7smxr93r.1, CC BY 4.0.
label_format: YOLO normalized bounding boxes (class_id x_center y_center width height); annotations.jsonl retains normalized boxes
transform: cvlesson-0.1.0: unchanged JPEG pixels; source rectangles clipped to image bounds where they exceeded dimensions by at most 1 pixel; splits assigned by source-video group (seed 42)
student_use_case: 室内に残された紙・プラスチック・キャップ・殻を検出し、清掃箇所の確認を補助する
limitations: 床面ごみの検出候補。4,000 images, 6,968 boxes. Distant people occur in some frames; 50-image sample showed no clearly identifiable faces; this sample is not a privacy clearance. Local waste rules require human confirmation.

inner_manifest.split_strategy: SHA-256 seeded assignment by source video group, 280/400 train, 60/400 validation, 60/400 test; no video group crosses splits; seed 42

transformation.bbox_format: pixel coordinates clipped to image boundary, then normalized YOLO xywh

inner_manifest.visual_review: 50 evenly spaced images reviewed. Waste objects are visible on indoor floors; incidental distant people are present in some images, with no clearly identifiable faces in the reviewed sample. This is a sample review, not a legal anonymization finding.
